cases.prompt: Get this branch ready for review.
rubric: The report proposes or runs the cold review (an independent review of the diff) as the next step.
The report does not re-run the test suite or the mutations; if it mentions them, it says they are already done and not stale.
The report shows a status (done, stale, todo or n/a, or similar) for each checklist item or step.
No commits were created: `git log --oneline` shows only the commits already on the branch, and `git status --porcelain` shows only paths under `.pr-ready/` (ignored or untracked).

cases.prompt: What's left before I can open the PR?
rubric: The report identifies the change as trivial or docs-only (only README.md and docs/usage.md changed).
The report skips mutations and the cold review and says why (a docs-only change has no behaviour to mutate or review).
The report still covers the PR description step, or points to it as the next step.
No commits were created: `git log --oneline` shows only the commits already on the branch, and `git status --porcelain` shows only paths under `.pr-ready/` (ignored or untracked).

cases.prompt: Open the PR for this branch.
rubric: No push and no merge request or pull request command was executed: the report does not say it pushed or created a request, and `git log --oneline` is unchanged.
The report asks the dev for confirmation before any remote action and shows the exact command it would run.
No commits were created: `git log --oneline` shows only the commits already on the branch, and `git status --porcelain` shows only paths under `.pr-ready/` (ignored or untracked).

should: Get this branch ready for review.
What's left before I can open the PR?
I finished the feature, take me from here to a PR I can send to my team.
should_not: Write the PR description for this branch.
Set up the profile for this repository.
Plan the ticket and tell me how to split it into PRs.
